body.p: Requirement to boot from Hub-Die E-core is mainly for compatibility support. Razor Lake SoC shall boot with Nova Lake BIOS/IFWI using Hub-Die E-core. Prompt option to user to update the appropriate IFWI image and OS image. Hub-Die E-core has only L2 Cache (only MLC and no LLC) and is 4MB. BIOS cacheable code should fit within 4MB including data/heap.
